title: Reverse a LinkedList [Iterative]
statementHtml: Given the head of a singly linked list. Reverse the given linked list and return the head of the modified list.
examples:
Input: head -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5

Output: head -> 5 -> 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1

Explanation: All the links are reversed and the head now points to the last node of the original list.

Input: head -> 6 -> 8

Output: head -> 8 -> 6

Explanation: All the links are reversed and the head now points to the last node of the original list.

This can be seen like: 6 <- 8 <- head.
constraintsHtml:
• 0 <= number of nodes in the Linked List <= 105
  • 0 <= ListNode.val <= 104
